provenance.authoring: Original reconstruction by this authorized project agent. Prior project primitives and static batching reused; no downloaded mesh, photo textures, transit logos or advertisements.
provenance.license: Vancouver Living Atlas Noncommercial Research and Attribution 1.0
provenance.dimensions: Project frame preserved, seats and raised rear are representative modelling approximations.

lods.capabilityScope: Offline geometry composed with unchanged original exterior; runtime integration remains pending.
Offline geometry composed with unchanged original exterior; runtime integration remains pending.

assets.dimensionBasis: Original game-ready approximation within existing project 12 m bus frame. Photos inform visual features, never surveyed dimensions or a fleet-identical seat count.

pivot.meaning: Tyre-contact datum at midpoint of front/rear axle centres

textureCost.note: 11 shared PBR material-role batches per LOD; no per-seat texture or photo texture.

lodPolicy.stateRule: Retain interior LOD0 or LOD1 and original exterior LOD0/1 for any occupant. Rear deck access requires per-character headroom validation. Never board with exterior LOD2.
lodPolicy.residentRule: Lazy-load interior for occupied or inspected buses only.

clearance.note: 1.95 m standing reference is restricted to the low-floor area; rear raised deck is seated-only for the existing fixed-anchor consumer.

collision.note: Door proxies must animate with leaf transform; never use a solid body AABB for occupied state.

placementCompatibility.sourceRequirement: Consumer-selected road service transform and surveyed stop/walk-surface alignment. No fixed world XYZ.

runtimeChecks.reason: Supplement only. Not copied into public runtime, not integrated, not WebGL tested, not boarding acceptance.

appearance.source: User requested darker navy bus cushions; checked against photographed WVMT XD40 1210. Material changed in GLBs, AgX exposure unchanged.

vehicles.dimensionBasis: Representative project modelling target, not a specific New Flyer survey or accessibility certification

legacyToVehicleRoot.note: Datum conversion only from old local contact Y=.01 and axle midpoint Z=-.025. This newly proportioned model is not a vertexwise legacy mapping. Remove old runtime ground+1.08 offset.

walkableFloor.rule: Floor surfaces are support areas; subtract obstacles and test headroom. Do not treat full floor rectangles as unobstructed navigation polygons.

collision.dynamicRule: Transform each animated-door-leaf proxy by its frame keyframes; floor metadata remains vehicle-local.

composition.dependencyPolicy: Resolve exterior only through the hash-pinned dependency. Do not load old interior with this replacement. Metadata namespaces refer to the same vehicle frame.

interiorLayout.layoutBasis: Photographed WVMT 2012 XD40 topology adapted to preserved representative project frame; seat count and dimensions are authored, not fleet capacity.

nonStandingRegions.note: Not offered as a standing anchor. Free walking and ingress to rear seats require later per-character fit logic.

reservedAccessibilityRegions.note: 0.58 x 1.50 m representative bay with right-side folding seats stowed; full-area conservative envelope excludes the boundary rails. Not regulatory certification.

limitations: Photographic style reference, not a surveyed replica.
Rear standing is not exposed to the current passenger adapter: 1.92 m headroom is insufficient for the 1.95 m contract.
Runtime pathfinding, step traversal, seated animation and WebGL not accepted.

scope.recovery: New reconstruction of missing supplement; not a byte-identical recovery.
